$comment: Annual style: the key-figures spread of a calm annual report, for investors and the board. Aubergine and gold, light-weight numerals, a tinted message band, AC columns with a PY marker line and numbered callouts, ranked bars with a PY marker.

meta.label: Annual
meta.summary: An annual-report spread: a tinted message band, light-weight numerals, AC columns and bars with a PY marker line, numbered callouts, generous space.
meta.brandSlot: color.*.scenario.ac, color.*.scenario.pl, color.*.scenario.fc, color.*.accent.*, color.*.surface.panel, typography.family.*

relaxes.what: A tinted band behind the key message and white (dark: plum) panels without boxes.
relaxes.why: The annual-report cover gesture: one focal point per page.
relaxes.condition: The tint is the brand surface, never green or red, and never encodes data.

relaxes.what: Light-weight display numerals (44 px) for the KPI values.
relaxes.why: The calm, generous voice of an annual report; labels and variances stay regular weight.
Read in print and on screens at a distance.

relaxes.what: PY drawn as a marker line across the AC column or bar, not as a second column or bar.
relaxes.why: One solid shape per category reads calmer; the marker keeps the comparison exact.
relaxes.condition: AC stays solid, PY the marker; both are named in the legend.

relaxes.what: AC in the aubergine brand colour instead of a neutral dark grey.
relaxes.why: The brand carries the report; the colour is far from every impact hue and AC stays clearly stronger than PY (checked).
One message per spread; detail lives in the IBCS page.
